method: Draft visual reading of original Hindi PDF; founder language and eligibility review required
evidenceNotes: Printed page 1 states online application 10 September 2026 noon through 9 October 2026 23:59.
Printed page 1 lists two separate laboratory posts and vacancies; printed page 5 clause 11(ii) requires separate applications for each post under one registration ID.

Printed page 1 invites Indian citizens and other candidate categories recognized by Government of India. The recognized categories and required documentation need review; no foreign-applicant pass or fail is inferred.
Printed page 5 distinguishes fee treatment of Chhattisgarh residents and applicants residing outside the state. Local reservation benefits are not treated as a blanket application ban.
Printed examination-scheme page states Hindi and English paper medium; no independent standardized language proficiency level has been identified.
